title: Trump 401(k) Proposal Shows Signs of Phony Supportive Comments
title_cn: 特朗普 401(k) 提案显示虚假支持评论的迹象
summary: A review of almost 12,000 comments in favor of the administration’s proposed rule found submissions in the names of dead people.
